reply.text:
That one's outside what I can help with. HCG and post-cycle therapy are drugs, and I don't give amounts for any of them. The dose, and whether it's wise at all, is a conversation for a doctor who can check your bloodwork and your situation. If you're coming off a cycle, please get that medical guidance first rather than going by numbers from a forum.

I'm glad to help with the training side: how to structure your lifting while you sort that out, or where you stand on your lifts right now.
